request.style: English, warm female solo voice, acoustic guitar, piano, soft strings, gentle mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The acts of kings from beginning to end
Are written down for the people to learn
In records found in the ancient days
Where truth and history gently lay

[Pre-Chorus]
From Solomon’s throne to Rehoboam’s reign
The seer kept the sacred chain

[Chorus]
Visions of Iddo the seer
Speaking concerning Jeroboam
His words are the light that we keep
Guiding the hearts in a gentle sweep

[Verse]
Shemaiah’s notes and the genealogies
Tell of the wars and the histories
Abijah’s ways and his spoken words
Are recorded in the prophet’s chords

[Pre-Chorus]
From the days of old to the returning
A spiritual line is forever turning

[Chorus]
Visions of Iddo the seer
Speaking concerning Jeroboam
His words are the light that we keep
Guiding the hearts in a gentle sweep

[Bridge]
Zechariah son of Iddo stands
In the name of the God of the lands
Haggai and Zechariah prophesy
Building the temple with faith and glee

[Outro]
The elders built and they prospered on
Through the prophesying until they were done
